romanized_text:
arav aur riy ek hi skul men padhate the aur pakke dost the. ek din skul men vijnana mele ki ghoshan hui. arav bahut utsahit hokar riy ke pas daudaa aur bol, riya, hamen is bar kuch jabaradasta banan hai. agar ham jit gae to pure skul men hamar nam hog. riy ne hansate hue kaha, bilkula, chal aj se hi shuru karate hain.

donon ne milakar ek chot robot banane k phaisal kiya. lekin kuch hi dinon men mushkilen ane lagin. ek sham robot k sarkit bara-bara jal jata tha. arav jhunjhal kara bol, yaha kam hi nahin kara rah. mainne itani mehanat ki aur sab bekar j rah hai. riy ne use shant karate hue kaha, itana pareshan mat ho, ham phir se koshish karenge.

usi rat arav apani dadi ke pas gaya aur sari bat batai. dadi ghar ki sabase bujaurg sadasy thin. arav ne kaha, dadi, mujhe lagat hai main har jaung. dadi ne pyar se usak sir sahalay aur bolin, beta, dhairy rakho. mehanat kabhi bekar nahin jati. har asaphalat kuch sikhati hai. arav ko unaki bat se nai himmat mili.

agale din vijnana mele men adhyapak sharm sabhi pariyojanaon ki janch kara rahe the. ve apani sakhati ke lie jane jate the. unhonne arav se puch, tumane yaha robot kaise banay aur isak asali upayog kya hai? arav ne shanti se har saval k uttar diya. adhyapak sharm ne sir hilakar kaha, tumhari mehanat sapha dikhai deti hai.

parinam ki ghoshan hui aur arav tath riy ki tim pratham ai. riy khushi se chillai, hama jit gae! mujhe yakin hi nahin ho rah. arav ne hansate hue kaha, mainne kaha tha n, ham kamal kara denge. us sham donon doston ne apani jit k jashn manay aur dadi ko dhanyavad kaha jinaki baton ne unhen kabhi har nahin manane di.

key_events: Announcement of a science fair at the school
Arav excitedly runs to Riy and proposes to create an amazing project for the fair
Riy laughs and agrees to start the project immediately
event_chain.scene_goal: Arav and Riy decide to collaborate on a project for the upcoming science fair
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the first scene, Arav now proposes a project to Riy

key_events: Arav and Riy decide to build a small robot together
The robot repeatedly catches fire during testing
Riy calms them and promises to try again
event_chain.scene_goal: Shows the initial attempt at building the robot and the challenges faced, setting up future perseverance
event_chain.narrative_link: Following their decision to collaborate on a project for the upcoming science fair, Arav and Riy now attempt to build a robot but encounter setbacks

key_events: Arav visits his grandmother and shares his feelings about his confidence in winning
Grandmother gives him advice and encouragement, telling him to be patient and that hard work never goes to waste
Arav gains new courage from his grandmother’s words
event_chain.scene_goal: Arav receives encouragement and renewed confidence to persevere in his robot-building efforts
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the initial attempt at building the robot and the challenges faced, Arav now seeks guidance from his grandmother

key_events: Adhyapak Sharm checks all projects at the science fair
He asks Arav how he built the robot and its real use
Arav calmly answers all questions
Sharm nods and praises Arav’s hard work
event_chain.scene_goal: Reinforces Arav’s confidence and showcases his expertise
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the previous encouragement, Arav now confidently answers questions about his robot

Riy cheers, exclaiming that they have won
Arav laughs and affirms that they will perform excellently
That evening the two friends celebrate their victory and thank their grandmother
